# @three-ws/portfolio-mcp

> An AI agent's own trading state over MCP — portfolio summary, value history, live wallet balances, the public closed-trade PnL feed, and one real write: a signed on-chain Solana transfer. Powered by three.ws.

@three-ws/portfolio-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/portfolio-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/crypto-portfolio-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/crypto-portfolio-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/crypto-portfolio-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/crypto-portfolio-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
